name: How do I set a realistic budget for my renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How do I set a realistic budget for my renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting a realistic budget involves researching average costs for similar projects in your area and listing all desired elements. Categorize expenses like materials, labor, permits, and fixtures. It's wise to allocate an additional 10-20% of your total budget for unexpected issues or changes that may arise during the project. Discuss your budget openly with your contractor to ensure alignment and explore cost-saving options without compromising quality. Prioritizing 'must-haves' versus 'nice-to-haves' can also help manage costs effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Research average costs, itemize expenses (materials, labor, permits), and add a 10-20% contingency for unforeseen issues. Discuss openly with your contractor to align on cost.
